# St. Teresa Vidya Deep Senior Secondary School (STVDS)
> English Medium Co-Educational Senior Secondary Institution in Udaipur, Rajasthan. Affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi. Managed by the registered Prabhudasi Sisters Educational Society (Ajmer).

## Institutional Profile
- **Institution Name:** St. Teresa Vidya Deep Senior Secondary School (STVDS)
- **Motto:** SEEK YE WISDOM
- **Year of Establishment:** 1996 (28+ Years of Academic Stewardship)
- **Affiliation:** Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, India
- **Medium of Instruction:** English
- **Pattern:** Co-Educational Day School (Nursery to Class XII)
- **Governance:** Prabhudasi Sisters Educational Society (Ajmer)
- **Principal:** Sr. Ranjana
- **Official Website:** https://stteresavidyadeep.org

## Academic Wings & Curriculum Structure
STVDS delivers the comprehensive CBSE National Curriculum Framework (NCF):
1. **Pre-Primary Wing (Early Years Foundation):** Nursery, LKG, UKG (Ages 3 to 5). Play-way learning, phonetics, sensory motor skills.
2. **Primary Wing (Classes 1 to 5):** Foundational literacy, numeracy, environmental studies, Hindi, English, computer fundamentals, arts.
3. **Middle Wing (Classes 6 to 8):** Experiential science, mathematics, social studies, languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit), coding and life skills.
4. **Secondary Wing (Classes 9 & 10):** Rigorous CBSE Board syllabus preparing students for All India Secondary School Examination (AISSE).
5. **Senior Secondary Wing (Classes 11 & 12):** All India Senior School Certificate Examination (AISSCE) in three specialized streams:
   - **Science Stream:** Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Computer Science / Informatics Practices, Physical Education, English Core.
   - **Commerce Stream:** Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, Applied Mathematics / Informatics Practices, English Core.
   - **Humanities / Arts Stream:** History, Political Science, Economics, Psychology / Geography, English Core.

## Campus Infrastructure & Facilities
- **Science Laboratories:** Dedicated, modern practical laboratories for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology complying with CBSE standards.
- **Computer & Digital Lab:** High-speed internet connected workstations, digital learning modules.
- **Library & Learning Resource Centre:** Curated collection of 4,500+ reference volumes, periodicals, encyclopedia sets, and fiction.
- **Sports & Athletic Complex:** 2.5-acre dedicated grounds supporting volleyball, football, cricket net practice, badminton, and track athletics.
- **Smart Classrooms:** Digitally equipped interactive multimedia panels.
- **Campus Safety & Transport:** Complete CCTV perimeter coverage, fire safety certified, clean RO drinking water plants, and verified GPS-enabled school bus transportation covering major Udaipur residential sectors.
